content.title: MLB® The Show™ - New Legends Albert Pujols, Dustin Pedroia, & Andruw Jones lead the charge in MLB The Show 26
content.text: Now introducing your MLB The Show 26 New Legends! We’ve got some major star power joining the Legends lineup this year including Albert Pujols, Dustin Pedroia, and Andruw Jones, as well as 40+ more New Legends like Felix Hernandez, Phil Rizzuto, and Red Shoendienst to name a few. These game-changing players revolutionized baseball, and their accomplishments on the field inspired the game’s next generations to match their greatness. We’ve also got returning Legends who left their lasting mark on the game like Mickey Mantle, Roberto Clemente, Randy Johnson, Hank Aaron, Ken Griffey Jr., and more. With more than 200 iconic players, spanning every era of baseball, you can collect them all to build the team of your dreams and rewrite history. Play with all these greats in Diamond Dynasty*, Home Run Derby, Storylines*: Negro Leagues – Season 4 and Franchise. See if you can reach legendary status, too. Relive Baseball’s Rich History Plus, be sure to check out even more Legends with the return of Storylines: The Negro Leagues – Season 4*. Experience a symphony of greatness, discovering iconic plays from Negro League players like Roy Campanella, George “Mule” Shuttles, Mamie “Peanut” Johnson, John Henry “Pop” Lloyd, and more in MLB The Show 26. Immerse yourself in a world of gameplay, historic footage, and storytelling that dives into the tales behind the on-field action. Now & Later Packs Are Back Don’t forget, you can earn your packs in the XP Path and Now & Later Program in ‘25 and get vouchers that will automatically be redeemed¹ into The Show Packs when logging into MLB The Show 26 with the same account you used in ‘25. You can score up to 12 additional packs, plus get a Carlos Beltrán player item to use in MLB The Show 25 and a different Carlos Beltrán player item in ‘26. Pre-order MLB The Show Now MLB The Show 26 is available to pre-order now in the Standard Edition and Digital Deluxe Edition. Want Early Access? Choose the Digital Deluxe Edition and start playing on March 13th, 2026 – four full days before the official release on March 17th. Get inspired by these Legends to leave your mark on the game like never before. Pre-order Loyalty Discount For Previous MLB The Show Owners! We’re also happy to announce a new loyalty discount. You will receive 10% off your Digital Deluxe Edition pre-order1 if you have purchased any digital version of MLB® The Show™ that’s been released since MLB® The Show™ 21². The pre-order loyalty discount expires when the game launches on March 17th. *Internet connection required. 1Discount reflected in cart. Must be signed into your account. Only applies to same platform purchases. 2For Nintendo Switch, since MLB® The Show™ 22
